scope_decisions.numeric_risk_caps: none; the operator controls exposure through entered order amount, attempt count, and margin allocation
scope_decisions.forward_fill_mismatch_numeric_tolerance: none; a both-filled mismatch is recorded but does not by itself trigger a numeric-threshold pause
scope_decisions.fill_and_residual_policy: actual filled quantities, values, residuals, partial states, and prior unresolved attempts are persisted and queried but do not gate the next immediate scheduled pair
scope_decisions.order_acceptance_and_reconciliation: a returned orderId is accepted-order evidence; persist it and query to terminal state; timeout/missing response first queries deterministic client order ID and never blindly resends
scope_decisions.immediate_cadence: each running task card owns an independent asynchronous scheduler that submits one concurrent hedge pair every 1 second; multiple tasks may submit in the same second; order-status tracking runs independently and does not block that task's next pair
scope_decisions.confirmed_failure_pause: configurable consecutive_failure_pause_threshold defaults to 3; reaching it pauses further opening; a successful accepted pair resets the counter
scope_decisions.fill_accounting: persist cumulative actual base and quote quantities per leg and calculate weighted average price as cumulative quote divided by cumulative base; data is audit/display only in this stage
scope_decisions.smooth_mode: deferred to a separate next stage; each future smooth task will own its own WebSocket price-spread monitor and trigger only when its own spread-rate condition is met
scope_decisions.forward_spot_market_buy_working_rule: send base quantity q_common, not quoteOrderQty; fixed base quantity is the frontend input and both hedge legs submit it concurrently
scope_decisions.forward_execution_policy: concurrent; persist one attempt before both POSTs, then submit two fixed-q_common legs concurrently
scope_decisions.input_semantics: single_amount is fixed base-asset quantity per attempt and target_n is number of attempts
scope_decisions.decimal_contract: spot and UM quantities and preflight price/notional estimates have independent decimal/filter rules; use Decimal fixed-point and per-leg formatting
scope_decisions.account_contract: regular Portfolio Margin as documented in the repository PRD; PM-Pro is out of this stage unless the user corrects this assumption
